gaps.hint: noun: the state of being free from rule
gaps.explanation: 'Gain independence' = become self-governing; the noun form follows the verb.

gaps.sentence: The law needs complete ___ (REVISE) before it can work.
The ___ (SAFE) of passengers is our priority.
gaps.explanation: 'Safety' — the quality noun from safe (safe → safety).

gaps.sentence: She beat three hundred ___ (COMPETE) for the title.
gaps.hint: plural noun: the people she beat
gaps.explanation: 'Three hundred competitors' — plural noun for the people taking part.

gaps.sentence: The hotel is ___ (CONVENIENT) situated near the station.
gaps.explanation: 'Conveniently situated' — the adverb modifies the participle.

gaps.sentence: Her sudden ___ (DIE) shocked the whole village.
gaps.explanation: 'Her sudden death' — 'die' is the verb, 'death' the noun.
